manual_recovery_reason: Owner requested five new bilingual WEBU Journal articles on 2026-11-11; rerun the verified DOI editorial publisher without paid APIs.

editorial_quality.priority: accuracy, faithful translation, transparent original sources and usefulness to entrepreneurs ahead of word count or daily quota

editorial_mission.purpose: find recent peer-reviewed research; provide transparent Slovak translations of key findings, concise summaries, and clear links to original research
editorial_mission.content_type: research summaries and critical contextualisation, not original peer-reviewed scientific papers or full translations of copyrighted papers
editorial_mission.no_forced_connections: never add website-development advertising, WEBU service pitches, or imagined business relevance to an unrelated source
editorial_mission.relevance_gate: study title must clearly address a business-related subject before automatic publication
editorial_mission.source_access: Crossref abstract only unless original full text is separately verified
editorial_mission.daily_goal: up to five high-quality paired SK/EN articles; inadequate sources remain unpublished
